title: ARS Edit Director Agent — Input (Ingest precondition gate + mode-agnostic Asset Manifest + denormalized creative intent)
description: Validates the v1.0 input of the Edit Director Agent (Agent #9 of 17 — the first creative-AUTHORING agent in the post tail, the 9th defense-in-depth firewall pass, the first contractually mode-BLIND agent). Authored Day 62 (Sat Jun 20 2026) from SPEC §2 Inputs (Day 58 outline) + §10 Field Map 27 rows (Day 59 partial 1) + §10.3 no-touch rows + §10.4 schema authoring note + §10.5 authoring-by-tier matrix + §16 metadata block (Day 60 partial 2). TWO defining input characteristics, both inherited from the proven Ingest input shape (5th reuse): (1) the Ingest precondition gate — Edit Director reads the Asset Manifest verdict FIRST and never directs an un-ingested reel (Hard Rule #4 / Decision D4 / Step 1 / Check #1); the runtime gate is asset_manifest.verdict == 'pass' OR a Lever-3 sign-off attached, else halt upstream_ingest_not_passed. (2) mode-BLINDNESS — production_mode is PRESENT in metadata for audit lineage but is the strongest no-touch field in the fleet (§10.3): Edit Director NEVER reads it as a branch discriminator (Hard Rule #6), and its output attests mode_blind_confirm.production_mode_read:false. UNLIKE Ingest, there is NO polymorphic-source oneOf split here — the Asset Manifest is already mode-converged (asset_bundle is byte-shape-identical regardless of origin mode, the TC-01/TC-02 convergence proof), so Edit Director consumes ONE source shape for all three modes. Like every prior ARS schema this is single-file (no external $ref resolution): the consumed Asset Manifest deep internals are validated by the LOCKED Ingest output.schema.json (read-only) and left permissive here (additionalProperties true) to avoid canon drift; this schema constrains the edit-relevant envelope + the fields the 11-check self-QC adjudicates. A consumed errorEnvelope (output_type != successAssetManifest) is a runtime halt (upstream_not_success — Check #2), NOT a schema rejection. parent_chain inbound = Ingest's 7-tuple, HELD ADDITIVELY (minItems 5 accepts the 5-tuple pre-ratification canon; maxItems 7 accepts the QC 6-tuple + Ingest 7-tuple extension previews; items false). Edit Director appends its own edit_plan_id at position 7 on OUTPUT (see output.schema.json — 8-tuple, also held additively). TODO@cross-spec-3.9-ratification: when the n-tuple amendment ratifies AND the Ingest 7-tuple LOCKs AND the QC 6-tuple LOCKs, flip inbound to minItems 7 (exact-7). The 7-tuple inbound + 8-tuple outbound are NOT auto-advanced this run (Decision D6 — triply-deferred).

asset_manifest.description: §2 PRIMARY input + the Ingest precondition gate (Hard Rule #4 / Decision D4 / Step 1 / Checks #1+#2). Edit Director reads this FIRST. TWO runtime gates (both halts, NOT schema rejections — a non-pass / errorEnvelope manifest is a valid object, an invalid direction-source): (1) output_type == 'successAssetManifest' else halt upstream_not_success (Check #2 — cannot direct a failed ingest output); (2) verdict == 'pass' OR lever3_signoff_present == true else halt upstream_ingest_not_passed (Check #1). Deep manifest internals (the full Ingest successAssetManifest payload) are owned by the LOCKED Ingest output.schema.json (read-only); only the edit-relevant envelope is constrained here. Edit Director TRUSTS Ingest's asset_firewall_pass_8 (the assets are clean — §10.3 no-touch) and runs its OWN 9th firewall pass over AUTHORED text only.

output_type.description: The Ingest output discriminator. Edit Director proceeds ONLY on 'successAssetManifest'; an inbound errorEnvelope => upstream_not_success at runtime (Check #2). Permissive enum accepts either Ingest branch value so the agent can READ + halt on a failed manifest rather than schema-rejecting it.

verdict.description: The upstream Ingest verdict (Ingest emits pass | fail | reshoot — no 'hold'). Edit Director directs ONLY on 'pass' OR an attached Lever-3 sign-off; any other value with no sign-off => upstream_ingest_not_passed at runtime (Check #1).

lever3_signoff.description: OPTIONAL human Lever-3 sign-off — the ONLY bypass of the Ingest-pass precondition (Decision D4). Presence with signoff_present:true permits direction of a non-pass reel. Absent / null on the normal pass path.

asset_bundle.description: §10 rows 11+17 — the mode-CONVERGED editor pull list (byte-shape-identical regardless of ingested mode — the convergence guarantee Edit Director consumes mode-blind). raw_footage is the cut basis (shot_ref + asset_uri + duration_sec authored into cut_order); audio + music_bed feed the swell map; assets_pulled names the lt_* mogrt templates. Deep internals owned by the Ingest schema (read-only).

raw_footage.description: Normalized per-shot footage rows. The cut_order authoring basis (§10 row 11): shot_ref + asset_uri passthrough, duration_sec the bound for the authored in_ms/out_ms.

audio.description: Flat normalized audio URI list (read context for the swell map; sync was already adjudicated at Ingest spec_check).

assets_pulled.description: OPTIONAL — brand-asset filename list (logo, lt_* lower-third mogrt templates) — Ingest-firewall-confirmed (§10.3 no-touch), referenced by lower_thirds[*].style.

music_bed.description: OPTIONAL — single music-bed URI passthrough into edit_plan.music_bed (§10 row 17). Platform-relative ars:// (Hard Rule #8).

coverage_check.description: §10.3 read-only — Edit Director reads coverage_complete + shots_required to DEFENSIVELY re-confirm coverage (Check #3, coverage part) before authoring a cut; it does NOT re-echo the per-asset spec adjudication (Ingest's jurisdiction). A coverage hole here => incomplete_shot_coverage (route back to Ingest).

script_ref.description: §2 / §10 rows 13–16 — denormalized Script Agent creative intent carried for the intent-TRANSFORM rows. voice_pacing (wpm) feeds pacing_bpm + cut_rhythm (declared-tempo heuristic — Hard Rule #9, NO byte-level beat detection v1.0); captions feed caption_style + caption_lines (copy passthrough, NOT re-authored — Hard Rule #8; at_ms AUTHORED to the cut); on_screen_text feeds lower_thirds. Deep internals owned by the Script Agent output.schema.json (read-only).

audio_track.description: Carries voice_pacing (wpm) — the pacing-heuristic basis (§10 row 13). NO byte-level audio decode (Hard Rule #9).

voice_pacing.description: Declared narration tempo in words-per-minute (e.g. 165). Heuristic input to pacing_bpm + cut_rhythm; never decoded.

captions.description: Script caption strategy (§10 rows 15–16). The burn-in style + per-line copy. Copy is passthrough (Hard Rule #8 — Edit Director times it, never re-writes it). A line that cannot fit <=22 chars => caption_spec_violation (Check #8).

on_screen_text.description: Script-authored lower-third / on-screen copy (§10 row 16). Content passthrough into lower_thirds[*].content; case 'lowercase' + align 'left' are ENFORCED brand rules on output; at_ms AUTHORED.

storyboard_ref.description: §2 / §10 row 12 — denormalized Storyboard frame language. shot_list[*].frame_language is joined onto each cut_order entry by shot_ref (passthrough — Edit Director directs WHICH ORDER, not HOW framed; framing is Storyboard's jurisdiction). total_shots is the coverage-cardinality re-confirm basis (Check #3).

total_shots.description: The required-coverage cardinality (coverage_remap.shots_required == storyboard_ref.total_shots — no phantom mapping, Check #3).

shot_list.description: Per-shot frame language carried denormalized (joined by shot_ref onto cut_order). Deep internals owned by the Storyboard output.schema.json (read-only).

preflight_report.description: OPTIONAL §10.3 read-only context — denormalized QC Pre-flight cost-ledger reference. Edit Director carries NO cost fields beyond its own cost_incurred_usd (Hard Rule #10 — no cost re-litigation; the ceilings are QC Pre-flight's jurisdiction, restated here for traceability only, never re-adjudicated). Deep internals owned by the QC Pre-flight output.schema.json (read-only).

assetManifestId.description: Ingest's emitted identity (UUIDv7 per Cross-SPEC §3.9 ID canon) + the 7th inbound parent_chain element (position 6). UUIDv7 validates under the uuid format. This is the manifest Edit Director directs over.

preflightReportId.description: QC Pre-flight's emitted identity + the 6th parent_chain element. v1.0: ^preflight-REINVENTED-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN$ (multi-brand v1.1+ widens the prefix).

normalizedFootageRow.description: Ingest-relevant projection of a normalized footage row (the mode-converged shape — one shape regardless of origin mode). Edit Director reads shot_ref (cut census), asset_uri (ars:// platform-relative — Hard Rule #8 / echoed into cut_order), and duration_sec (the bound for the AUTHORED in_ms/out_ms). Deep internals owned by the Ingest schema (read-only).

asset_uri.description: Platform-relative ars:// URI (Hard Rule #8 — NO absolute URLs). Echoed verbatim into cut_order[*].asset_uri.

duration_sec.description: Declared shot duration — the upper bound for the authored in_ms/out_ms window (no double-spend, no timeline gap).

source.description: OPTIONAL read-context — the producing source (NOT read as a branch discriminator; Edit Director is mode-blind, Hard Rule #6).

sessionId.description: Inbound session identifier. Accepts Cross-SPEC §3.9 UUID(-v7) canon OR the established ars-/sess- prefixed forms (additive, backward-compatible — does not false-reject existing pipeline session ids). Single combined pattern avoids oneOf/format ambiguity (format is annotation-only under Draft 2020-12 default assertion behavior).

inboundParentChainHeld.description: Inbound lineage = Ingest's 7-tuple, HELD ADDITIVELY. positions 0-5 inherit the QC Pre-flight 6-tuple canon verbatim (ARS-2026-06-12-Ingest-input.schema.json inboundParentChainHeld + the QC extension); position 6 = the Ingest extension (asset_manifest_id, UUIDv7). minItems 5 ACCEPTS the 5-tuple pre-ratification canon; maxItems 7 ACCEPTS the QC 6-tuple AND Ingest 7-tuple extension previews; items false. REJECTS a 4-tuple. Edit Director validates a well-formed inbound chain (Step 2 / Check #9); malformed => plan_lineage_failure at runtime. Edit Director appends its own edit_plan_id at position 7 on OUTPUT (see output.schema.json — 8-tuple, also held additively). TODO@cross-spec-3.9-ratification: flip to minItems 7 (exact-7) when the n-tuple amendment ratifies AND the Ingest 7-tuple LOCKs AND the QC 6-tuple LOCKs (Decision D6 — triply-deferred, NOT auto-advanced this run).

inboundMetadataBlock.description: Cross-SPEC §3.9 inbound metadata carried from Ingest. Edit Director reads tier (authoring-richness scaling — §10.5; NOT verdict forking) / lever_state / parent_chain (7-tuple, held) / brand_id for context + the 9th-pass tier-mode re-validation (Check #4). production_mode is PRESENT for audit lineage but is the strongest NO-TOUCH field in the fleet (§10.3 / Hard Rule #6) — NEVER read as a branch discriminator; the output attests mode_blind_confirm.production_mode_read:false. There is NO source-shape oneOf in this schema BECAUSE the Asset Manifest is already mode-converged.

tier.description: Universal access — ALL 4 tiers traverse Edit Director at ~$0 (§4 / Decision D2). Plan RICHNESS scales by tier (§10.5 matrix); brand-rule compliance does NOT.

production_mode.description: Carried for audit lineage ONLY. NOT read as a branch (Hard Rule #6 / §10.3 — the strongest no-touch field). The output's mode_blind_confirm.production_mode_read:false attests it was never consulted.
